issues.description: No IPO LIBNAME assignment, autoexec or data/output directory configuration is supplied. The SAS source uses IPO.* tables and writes IPO.CRSP2 and IPO.DELIST through that unresolved libref, so the source inputs and persistent intermediate destinations are not bound.

The only supplied program visibly stops at a winsorization heading and contains no completed winsorization commands or downstream estimation/table-generation entry points. The final-sample CUSIPs are identifiers, not analysis data. Full paper-output workflow and any companion program mapping remain unresolved.
The first PROC SQL join predicate at line 74 opens a parenthesis but does not close it before the semicolon, so the supplied source has a supported narrow syntax defect.

If the missing prepared IPO.Text, IPO.Perception and IPO.WHR tables are not supplied, the documented upstream pipeline also needs Python-based EDGAR HTML removal/LM counting, Adobe Premiere Pro high-/low-pass video filtering before survey use, and ImageJ CEO-image measurements. The release supplies no such scripts, filtered clips, raw image mappings or survey responses, and it is unresolved which stages can be bypassed by prepared tables.
The code uses CEO_LAST_DATE to construct turnover indicators, but the datasheet does not identify whether IPO.Edgar or IPO.Roadshow supplies this field or define its date meaning.

The official French products and history are verified, but their current raw headers, ME units versus the author shares_post scale, daily portfolio-label ordering into P00-P99, and historical vintage comparable to the authors' 2016 inputs are not established by the pages checked. The official site reports a 2025 move to CRSP CIZ and monthly reconstruction of portfolio history.

dependency_review.description: IPO.Linking is a mandatory direct input; its base and manual-supplement compatibility remain unresolved.
IPO.SDC is a mandatory direct input joined to IPO.Linking.
IPO.Ritter is a mandatory direct input for founding year, underwriter and shares_post.
IPO.Compustat is a mandatory direct pre-IPO input; its p1* construction needs author data or a confirmed route.
IPO.Market is a mandatory direct input for the registration-period market conditions.
IPO.Edgar is a mandatory direct hand-collected characteristics input.
IPO.Roadshow is a mandatory direct hand-coded input; video non-distribution does not prove the derived table is unavailable.
IPO.CRSP is a mandatory direct daily pricing input.
IPO.CRSP2 is produced within this source from temp3/IPO.CRSP before its later use; its persistent library binding remains unresolved.
IPO.DELIST is produced from IPO.CRSP2 and is read by the later delisting join; the producer-consumer order is explicit.
IPO.Fama_MVE is a mandatory monthly cutoff input.
IPO.Fama_BTM is a mandatory annual cutoff input.
IPO.Fama daily 10x10 returns are mandatory; the local FF daily factor file is not a matching portfolio-return product.
IPO.Compustat_Post is a mandatory quarterly post-IPO input.
IPO.Perception is a mandatory direct survey-derived input; the supplied survey instrument is not response data.
IPO.Text is a mandatory direct input; SEC/LM path existence alone does not supply the prepared filing and transcript counts.
IPO.WHR is a mandatory direct measured image-ratio input.

actions.description: Obtain the exact author-prepared IPO.Linking, IPO.SDC, IPO.Ritter, IPO.Compustat, IPO.Market, IPO.CRSP and IPO.Compustat_Post inputs or a verified compatible route, together with their SAS field mappings, identifiers, periods and source/version details.
steps: For IPO.Linking, provide the author table and confirm the manually researched supplements beyond the CRSP/Compustat base link table and the CUSIP/name/LPERMNO/PERMNO/GVKEY/CIK mappings.

For IPO.SDC, confirm whether the local SDC.WRDS_NI_DETAILS product matches the author SDC Platinum Global New Issues extract; document its U.S. IPO population, dates, CUSIP edits, and mappings to issuer, issue_date, filing_amount, primary_shares, filing_shares, offer_price and mid_range.
For IPO.Ritter, provide the merged author table or the exact version/fields and merge steps for founding year, Carter-Manaster prestige and post-IPO shares.
For IPO.Compustat, provide the author IPO table or the exact quarterly/annual input and construction rules for the p1* fields, including pre-IPO selection, fallback and trailing-twelve-month periods.
For IPO.Compustat_Post, confirm the author table or local Compustat route covers the final sample for 2011-2015 with GVKEY, DATADATE, ATQ and NIQ.
For IPO.CRSP, provide the author table or confirm the daily CRSP construction, including how DLRET/DLSTCD are attached, identifiers and coverage through 2015.
For IPO.Market, provide the author table or exact Yahoo historical series/file format and the adjusted-close-to-RETD definition.
validation: Once supplied, use bounded metadata checks to confirm the required raw columns and compare the documented sample periods/identifiers; one-row reads do not establish full coverage.
Keep all author-specific manual additions and data transformations explicit; do not substitute the local candidate files without product, period and field confirmation.

actions.description: Acquire the verified official French public files for monthly ME breakpoints, annual BE/ME breakpoints and daily 100 size/book-to-market portfolios, then resolve the remaining source-to-SAS mappings.
steps: Acquire the official ME Breakpoints CSV/TXT and use the 10th, 20th, ..., 90th percentile cuts to form the nine monthly MV thresholds; inspect the published headers and document the ME unit before mapping them to mv1-mv9.

Acquire the official BE/ME Breakpoints CSV/TXT and use the 10th, 20th, ..., 90th percentile cuts to form the nine annual BTM thresholds; inspect the published headers and document the scale before mapping them to btm1-btm9.

Acquire the official daily 100 Portfolios Formed on Size and Book-to-Market file; map its exact size/book-to-market labels into the SAS P00-P99 convention and retain the documented daily return units.

Compare the current French file vintage with the authors' March 2016 data pull and assess the official site's note about CRSP CIZ and monthly history revisions; do not claim byte-identical history without a verified archive.
validation: After acquisition, verify the required 2011-2013 monthly/annual cutoff rows and daily return history through 2015, then confirm field labels and date keys against the SAS join conditions.
Confirm how author shares_post units map to the French ME scale and that all P00-P99 portfolio labels are generated in the same size/B/M order before joining returns.

actions.description: Request the author-prepared hand-collected, survey-derived and image/text measures, or exact supported source materials and collection specifications for those inputs.
steps: Provide IPO.Edgar with a sample filing/identifier map, field definitions and coding rules for CEO variables, employee ownership and CEO last date; confirm which SEC form/sections and years are in scope.

Provide IPO.Roadshow derived coding data or a permitted route to the 2011-2013 sample recordings and the manual coding instructions; clarify whether coded rows can be shared even though underlying video outtakes cannot.

Provide IPO.Perception table or qualifying Qualtrics response extract and the aggregation/exclusion rules needed for the six video/image rating variables; if rebuilding the video inputs, specify Adobe Premiere Pro high-/low-pass filter settings and clip selection.

Provide IPO.Text counts or the exact filing-section and roadshow transcript sources, transcript availability, Python HTML-removal/LM-count code and settings, dictionary version, and text-processing rules.
Provide IPO.WHR measurements or image-to-PERMNO mapping, ImageJ version and measurement procedure.
For SEC/LM local candidates, provide CIK/accession/sample identifiers and compatibility criteria before any file-level checks; the current probes only confirm documented roots/year directories exist.
Identify which prepared input table supplies CEO_LAST_DATE and define the date used for turnover indicators.
validation: After the author materials are supplied, check expected identifiers and fields, sample period, and data provenance; confirm that any manual/survey/image transformations reproduce the documented measures before SAS construction.

The SAS source identifies 15 direct IPO.* input tables. IPO.CRSP2 and IPO.DELIST are generated within the same SAS source; CRSP2 is produced before DELIST, and both are consumed later. All 17 frozen dependency IDs are reviewed.

Official Ken French pages verify downloadable monthly ME breakpoints, annual BE/ME breakpoints and daily 100 size/book-to-market portfolios with sufficient public history. The 5-percentile breakpoint files support selecting decile cuts; units, column/portfolio labels and 2016-vintage mapping remain unresolved.

The author documentation includes conditional Python HTML-removal/LM counts, Premiere Pro video filtering and ImageJ image measurement stages. Python is present, while Premiere Pro and ImageJ availability is unverified; prepared author tables may bypass those stages.

The bounded SAS probes read one row from exact catalog-listed candidate files; the SEC/LM probes only stat documented roots or year directories. None of those checks establishes population, full historical coverage, license entitlement, or author-table compatibility.

A one-line closing-parenthesis correction is proposed for the first SAS join predicate but was not applied. No author program, dataset download, software installation, or package change was performed; execution_verified remains false.
